title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Billing Standard: Calculation of the Late Fee
content:
**Clause.** The late fee on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is the greater of the class's flat late fee and the class's late-fee percentage of the contracted monthly rent, the percentage amount rounded to the cent, kept no higher than the class's late-fee ceiling. The late fee is charged in full, it is never less than the flat late fee, and the fee is rounded to the cent. The flat late fee, the late-fee percentage and the late-fee ceiling are the figures on the rate card of the agreement's space class.

Broken into its parts:

1. Percentage amount: the late-fee percentage of the class multiplied by the contracted monthly rent, rounded to the cent.
2. The greater of that amount and the flat late fee.
3. That figure kept no higher than the late-fee ceiling.
4. Charged in full, and never below the flat late fee.

### Worked figures (hypothetical rents)

| Space class and rent | Percentage amount | Greater of flat fee and percentage | Within ceiling | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space, $90.00 (flat $20.00, 20%, ceiling $40.00) | $18.00 | $20.00 | $20.00 | $20.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space, $170.00 | $34.00 | $34.00 | $34.00 | $34.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space, $260.00 | $52.00 | $52.00 | $40.00 | $40.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft), $425.00 (flat $35.00, 12%, ceiling $70.00) | $51.00 | $51.00 | $51.00 | $51.00 |

Points of judgement: the percentage is applied to the contracted monthly rent, not to the discounted rent charge; the flat fee works as a floor and the ceiling as a top, so on a low rent the flat fee is charged and on a high rent the ceiling is charged.
